invariants.rationale: The method throws IllegalArgumentException if name is null, so at the start of the method name is expected to be non-null.
The Class parameter is used as a key in a map, and in usual design, type should be non-null at method entry.
It is common for resource names to be non-empty strings, although not checked explicitly in the method.
Every Java class is an instance of Class, so this relation often holds; however, this is a generic relation and may or may not hold, included for coverage.
